mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods (type_id, name, cover_img, description, price, stock, sales, status) VALUES (#{typeId}, #{name}, #{coverImg}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, sales = sales + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE goods SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, sales = GREATEST(sales - #{quantity}, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
